title: Publish a release note safely
task: Move Draft Releases/worker note.md to Published Notes/worker.md. Keep Draft Releases/.keep and the unrelated API draft. From the lab root, write the published file’s relative path on one line in published.txt.
hints: Inspect both directories with ls -la and locate the worker draft.
Pass each path as one argument by quoting it. Use mv with the exact filename.
Check the destination with cat. Use printf to write the relative destination path and a newline to published.txt.

checks.label: The published note has the original contents
checks.feedback: Compare the worker note with what you read before moving it.
